description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105), removes KO [Raise: 100%], grants [Last Stand] and [Regenga] to all allies, grants [Awoken Dancer] to the user

description.name: Awoken Dancer
description.text: Dancer abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x3.00 for Dancer abilities, casts Barrier Dance after using Dancer abilities

description.name: Barrier Dance
description.text: Grants [10/15/20/30/40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] at rank 1/2/3/4/5 of the triggering ability to all allies

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: KO
description.text: Automatically set when HP reaches 0, prevents from acting, counts towards Game Over, persists after battle
